text: Finland has shorter than normal **white** plates with the standard European **blue strip** on the left.
NOTE: Åland has small, [fully white plates](https://goo.gl/maps/UoGQEzJqUPbe5bWX7) with blue lettering.
text_zh: 芬蘭擁有比正常情況更短的**白色**車牌，左側帶有標準的歐洲**藍色飾條**。
註記：奧蘭群島（Åland）擁有小型、[全白且帶有藍色字體的車牌](https://goo.gl/maps/UoGQEzJqUPbe5bWX7)。

text: Where present, outer road lines will always be **solid white lines**.
NOTE: Unlike Sweden and Norway, Finland does not use dashed outside lines. The only exception to this are the Åland Islands in southwest Finland, which do use dashes.
text_zh: 若有設置，外側道路標線一定會是**實線白線**。
註記：不同於瑞典和挪威，芬蘭不使用虛線外側標線。唯一的例外是位於芬蘭西南部的奧蘭群島，該處確實使用虛線。

text: Finland has several different types of **middle road lines**, including:
- [white dashes](https://goo.gl/maps/yQ7mJwXhJez2CDKa6), with or without a solid white line next to it
- [solid yellow with white dashes](https://goo.gl/maps/USv1DEYbXfne7ZsVA)
- [double yellow](https://goo.gl/maps/U3WZ4fLRZUEjuZFp8).
Yellow lines are being phased out and are increasingly rare in newer coverage.
NOTE: Sweden never has yellow middle lines. Norway has middle lines that have a distinct [orange tint](https://goo.gl/maps/pBepFW6otTJTFaDn6).
text_zh: 芬蘭有多種不同的**中線道路標線**，包括：
- [白色虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/yQ7mJwXhJez2CDKa6)，旁邊可能有或沒有實線白色道路標線
- [黃實線搭配白虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/USv1DEYbXfne7ZsVA)
- [雙黃線](https://goo.gl/maps/U3WZ4fLRZUEjuZFp8)。
黃色標線正在逐漸被淘汰，在較新的街景覆蓋中越來越少見。
注意：瑞典從不使用黃色中央標線。挪威的中央標線帶有明顯的[橘色調](https://goo.gl/maps/pBepFW6otTJTFaDn6)。

text: Finland has **long black-and-white bollards** with a rectangular, white reflector on the front and two dots on the back. They can be either round or thin and curved. The black strip is typically diagonal.
NOTE: They can look somewhat similar to bollards found in other Northern European countries. [This infographic](/images/finland/nordics_bollards.png) shows the differences.
text_zh: 芬蘭擁有**長型的黑白路樁**，正面有一個長方形的白色反光片，背面則有兩個圓點。它們可以是圓形的，或是較細且帶有弧度的。黑色條紋通常是斜向的。
注意：它們看起來可能與其他北歐國家的路樁有些相似。[此資訊圖表](/images/finland/nordics_bollards.png)顯示了其中的差異。

text: In Finland, it is common to find **orange snow poles** with a thin white band near the top.

NOTE: These are also found commonly in Norway and Sweden, but with a much [wider white band](https://i.imgur.com/R8PSzB4.png?1), lower down on the pole. They can also have multiple white bands, while Finnish snow poles usually have just one band.
text_zh: 在芬蘭，很常見到頂部附近帶有細白色條紋的**橘色雪樁**。
注意：這些在挪威和瑞典也很常見，但電線桿上有著[寬得多的白色帶子](https://i.imgur.com/R8PSzB4.png?1)，且位置較低。它們也可能有多條白色帶子，而芬蘭的雪標桿通常只有一條帶子。

text: The **Finnish language** is not related to most other European languages, so it has a very unique look. It has a lot of long words and double vowels. The Finnish alphabet includes the letters **ä** and **ö**.
NOTE: Estonian is closely related to Finnish, so it can look similar. Estonian uses the letters õ and ü, which are not used in Finnish.
text_zh: **芬蘭語**與大多數其他歐洲語言無關，因此外觀非常獨特。它有很多長單字和雙母音。芬蘭字母包含 **ä** 和 **ö**。
注意：愛沙尼亞語與芬蘭語高度相關，因此看起來可能很相似。愛沙尼亞語使用的是 õ 和 ü，這在芬蘭語中是不會出現的。

text: Most Finnish street names end in “**tie**” or “**katu**.” These are the Finnish words for road and street. Street signs most commonly have a white background with black text.
NOTE: You may find roads ending in “polku” and “kuja”.
text_zh: 大多數芬蘭的街道名稱以“**tie**”或“**katu**”結尾。這是芬蘭語中道路和街道的意思。路牌通常為白底黑字。
注意：你也可能會發現以「polku」和「kuja」結尾的道路。

text: Finnish road signs have a **yellow background**.
NOTE: Signs in Sweden and Iceland also have yellow backgrounds. Norway, however, has signs with a white background.
text_zh: 芬蘭的道路標誌採用**黃色背景**。
注意：瑞典和冰島的標誌也是黃色背景。然而，挪威的標誌則是白色背景。

text: On traffic signs that have a red border, you will find a thin **yellow stroke** on the edge of the sign.
NOTE: You will not see this in any other Nordic country.
text_zh: 在帶有紅色邊框的交通標誌上，你會發現標誌邊緣有一道細細的**黃色外框**。
注意：你在其他任何北歐國家都看不到這個特徵。

text: Finnish pedestrian signs have **5 stripes**.
NOTE: Pedestrian signs in Sweden and Norway **usually** have 4 stripes. In [rare cases](https://goo.gl/maps/wMS7W2CWGyAi4DJt9), you can find 5 stripes in Norway.
text_zh: 芬蘭的行人穿越標誌有 **5 條條紋**。
注意：瑞典和挪威的行人標誌**通常**有 4 條線紋。在[罕見情況下](https://goo.gl/maps/wMS7W2CWGyAi4DJt9)，你可以在挪威找到 5 條線紋。

text: Finnish **directional signs** consist of a solid blue background, white text, and a white border with guiding arrows.
text_zh: 芬蘭的**方向指示標誌**由純藍色背景、白色文字、白色邊框以及指引箭頭組成。

text: Finnish chevrons are **black with yellow arrows**.
NOTE: Norway and Iceland have similarly coloured chevrons. Sweden, on the other hand, has unique blue and yellow chevrons.
text_zh: 芬蘭的轉彎標誌是**黑底黃箭頭**。
注意：挪威和冰島也有顏色相似的轉彎標誌。另一方面，瑞典擁有獨特的藍黃相間轉彎標誌。

text: Finland primarily uses **wooden utility poles**. Most of them tend to have a simple design, but they can have a variety of poletops. Poles often have a street light attached to them.
NOTE: In Northern Europe, wooden poles are also common in Sweden, Norway, and Estonia.
text_zh: 芬蘭主要使用**木製電線桿**。它們大多數設計簡單，但桿頂可能有多種變化。電線桿上通常會附掛路燈。
注意：在北歐地區，木製電線桿在瑞典、挪威和愛沙尼亞也很常見。

text: Lamps attached to wooden poles in Finland are normally mounted to the **top **of the pole with a **double bolting**.

NOTE: Within Scandinavia, [Sweden](https://maps.app.goo.gl/B38WAHnBB6minmXg9) also uses double bolting. However, in Sweden the lamps are mounted further down and the lamp arms are usually not straight.
text_zh: 芬蘭木製電線桿上的路燈通常透過**雙螺栓**固定在電線桿的**頂端**。
註記：斯堪的納維亞境內，[瑞典](https://maps.app.goo.gl/B38WAHnBB6minmXg9)也使用雙螺栓。不過，在瑞典燈具安裝得較低，且燈桿通常不是直的。

text: Traffic signposts often have **blue and white** striped markings.

NOTE: This pattern can also be found in Sweden. While the same colour scheme is also common in [Estonia](https://www.google.com/maps/@58.3430383,26.7407475,3a,22.2y,264.88h,67.51t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sP587UApP9JnjyawxVML4YA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656), the markings typically have a wider shape and attach to the signpost in a looser way.
text_zh: 交通標誌柱通常有**藍白相間**的條紋標記。
註記：這種圖案在瑞典也能找到。雖然相同的配色方案在[愛沙尼亞](https://www.google.com/maps/@58.3430383,26.7407475,3a,22.2y,264.88h,67.51t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sP587UApP9JnjyawxVML4YA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)也很常見，但標記通常形狀較寬，且與標誌柱的連接方式較鬆散。

text: Most of Finland is covered by dense **boreal forests**. Pine trees are common, as well as birches, which are easily recognizable by their white trunks.
text_zh: 芬蘭大部分地區被密集的**北方針葉林**覆蓋。松樹很常見，樺樹也很普遍，其白色的樹幹非常容易辨認。

text: A lot of **Generation 3** coverage was taken in **autumn**, meaning that trees in this coverage often have distinct fall colours.

NOTE: This is significantly less common in Generation 3 coverage in the other Nordics. This means that when you are faced with a tough decision between countries, a fall vibe can be a good clue for Finland.
Take note that this season meta is not present in Generation 2 and Generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: 許多 **第 3 代** 覆蓋是在**秋天**拍攝的，這意味著此覆蓋範圍內的樹木通常具有明顯的秋季色彩。
註記：這在其他北歐國家的第三代街景中相當少見。這意味著當你在不同國家之間難以抉擇時，秋天的氛圍可以作為芬蘭的一個好線索。
請注意，這種季節特徵在第二代和第四代街景中並不存在。

text: **Lakes** are so common in Finland, that the country is also sometimes known as the Land of a Thousand Lakes. Usually, you do not have to drive long to find a body of water.
text_zh: 芬蘭的**湖泊**非常普遍，以至於該國有時也被稱為千湖之國。通常，你不需要開太遠的路就能找到水體。

text: **Finnish architecture** is mostly modern and utilitarian. Downtown areas tend to be very modern, with lots of apartment buildings and use of concrete. Suburbs mostly consist of freestanding single family homes. Many houses have wooden cladding. Like Sweden and Norway, some wooden buildings, especially in the countryside, are painted in a distinctive [dark red colour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falu_red).
text_zh: **芬蘭建築**大多現代且實用。市中心地區往往非常現代，有許多公寓大樓並大量使用混凝土。郊區大多由獨立的單戶住宅組成。許多房屋擁有木製外牆。就像瑞典和挪威一樣，一些木造建築（特別是在鄉村地區）被漆成獨特的[深紅色](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falu_red)。

text: Finland has two styles of **bus stop signs**, a blue and white one, and a yellow and black one.

NOTE: This can be used to tell Finland apart from Sweden, which has many different bus stop signs ([example](https://goo.gl/maps/h4BWBzQgVu4mtNgr6)), most of which have the names of the stops on them.
text_zh: 芬蘭有兩種風格的**公車站牌**，一種是藍白相間的，另一種是黃黑相間的。
註記：這可用於區分芬蘭和瑞典，瑞典有許多不同的公車站牌（[範例](https://goo.gl/maps/h4BWBzQgVu4mtNgr6)），其中大多數都標有站名。

text: **K-Market** and **S-Market** are two Finnish supermarket chains with recognizable logos. Both chains operate only in Finland.
K-Market is sometimes known as K-Supermarket or K-Citymarket.
text_zh: **K-Market** 和 **S-Market** 是兩個擁有辨識度高標誌的芬蘭連鎖超市。這兩家連鎖店僅在芬蘭營運。
K-Market 有時被稱為 K-Supermarket 或 K-Citymarket。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Finland. This camera is known as the **official Ari** (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur, and can be distinguished from Generation 2 by its lack of a sky halo and often somewhat brownish colours. A good map will not usually include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order to not be caught off-guard by it.
NOTE: Within Europe, Finland and Spain are the countries that have the most coverage with this camera. This camera should not be confused with unofficial coverage, which is also common in Finland.
text_zh: Google 在芬蘭使用了一種奇怪、低畫質的相機。這款相機被稱為 **官方阿里**（或「爛畫質相機」）。它有一個寬闊的環形車輛模糊處理，並且可以透過缺少天空光暈以及通常帶有些許棕色的色彩與第 2 代區分開來。好的地圖通常不會包含這種覆蓋，但了解它的存在是好的，以免被它殺個措手不及。
註記：在歐洲境內，芬蘭和西班牙是擁有最多這種相機街景的國家。這款相機不應與芬蘭也很常見的非官方街景混淆。

text: Finland also has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
NOTE: All of Northern Europe also has smallcam.
text_zh: 芬蘭也有第四代「小型相機（smallcam）」街景，其安裝位置比一般的第四代相機低，且具有相對大的圓形模糊，前方有一個小突起。模糊也可以是完全透明的，這使得它更難被發現。
註記：整個北歐地區也都有小型相機街景。

text: Finnish regional roads have 3- or 4-digit road numbers. The **first digit** of those road numbers is **region-specific**. These regions are distributed in a rough south-to-north order, starting from 1 in the south to 9 in the north.
These road numbers often appear on direction signs. Learning the regions can help with cutting down on scanning time for 5k’s, or give you a rough region to plonk in during quick no move games.
NOTE: Major roads with 2-digit road numbers do not adhere to this geographic pattern.
text_zh: 芬蘭的區域道路有 3 位數或 4 位數的道路編號。這些道路編號的**第一位數**是**依區域而異**的。這些區域大致由南向北排列，從南部的 1 開始到北部的 9 結束。
這些道路編號常出現在方向標誌上。熟悉這些地區有助於縮短完成 5k 的掃描時間，或在快速無移動遊戲中讓你有個大致的落點區域。
註記：具有 2 位數道路編號的主要道路不遵循這種地理模式。

text: Snow poles which have **2 long reflectors** can be found on bigger roads in Lapland.
NOTE: They can only be found in coverage from 2023 onward.
text_zh: 在拉普蘭的大型道路上可以找到帶有 **2 個長反光片**的雪樁。
註記：它們只能在 2023 年及之後的街景中找到。

text: Finland has a lot of farmlands, but the majority of them are concentrated near the west and south coast.
text_zh: 芬蘭有大量的農田，但大多數集中在西海岸和南海岸附近。

text: **Wind turbines** are most commonly found along the **west coast** of Finland, with some exceptions.
text_zh: **風力發電機**最常見於芬蘭的**西海岸**沿線，但也有一些例外。

text: **Small, stunted trees** with spindly, thin trunks are common in northern Finland.
text_zh: 長著纖細薄樹幹的**小型侏儒樹**在芬蘭北部很常見。

text: **Generation 3 snow coverage **is only found in far northwestern Lapland.
NOTE: Be careful: this tip is specifically about regular Generation 3 coverage. Generation 2, 4, and trekker snow coverage can be found elsewhere.
text_zh: **第 3 代雪地覆蓋**僅見於拉普蘭的最西北端。
註記：請注意：這項提示專門針對一般的第三代街景。第二代、第四代和徒步拍攝雪景可以在其他地方找到。

text: The **Swedish language** is common in some coastal areas in the south and the west. In these areas, bilingual Swedish or Finnish texts are common. If you see Swedish language in a Finnish setting, do not guess inland.
text_zh: **瑞典語**在南部和西部的某些沿海地區很常見。在這些地區，雙語的瑞典語或芬蘭語文字很常見。如果你在芬蘭的場景中看到瑞典語，請不要猜內陸。

text: The [**Sámi languages**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A1mi_languages) are spoken in the far north of Finland. In this region, you can sometimes find bilingual signs with place names in both Finnish and Sámi. Unlike Finnish, its alphabet uses the letter **c**.
text_zh: [**薩米語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A1mi_languages)通行於芬蘭的最北部。在該地區，有時可以找到同時標有芬蘭語和薩米語地名的雙語標誌。與芬蘭語不同的是，它的字母表使用了字母 **c**。

text: This slightly **tilted, long antenna** can be found in southwestern Finland.
NOTE: Do not mix it up with the straight long antenna.
text_zh: 這種稍微**傾斜的長天線**可以在芬蘭西南部找到。
註記：不要把它和筆直的长天線搞混了。

text: Generation 3 coverage with **no antenna** at all can be found in south-central Finland.
text_zh: 完全**沒有天線**的第 3 代覆蓋可以在芬蘭中南部找到。

text: **Åland** is a group of islands off the southwestern coast. It is an autonomous, mostly self-governing region of Finland with its own flag. Though it has a special status, for country streaks purposes it is still counted as part of Finland.
NOTE: Åland has no Generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: **奧蘭**是西南部海岸外的一群島嶼。它是芬蘭一個自治、大致自治的地區，擁有自己的旗幟。雖然它擁有特殊地位，但在國家連勝（country streaks）的用途中，它仍然被算作芬蘭的一部分。
註記：奧蘭群島沒有第四代街景。

text: Åland is **monolingually Swedish**. If you see only Swedish, and no Finnish language, but you suspect that you are in Finland, consider the Åland Islands.
text_zh: 奧蘭是**單一語言的瑞典語區**。如果你只看到瑞典語而沒有芬蘭語，但你懷疑自己身在芬蘭，請考慮奧蘭群島。

text: Åland roads have two unique aspects that separate them from the rest of Finland: their pavement tends to have a **red tint**, and they have **dashed** outside road lines that resemble those found in Sweden.
text_zh: 奧蘭的道路有兩個獨特之處，使它們與芬蘭其他地區區分開來：它們的路面通常帶有**紅色調**，並且它們擁有類似於瑞典道路的**虛線**外側道路標線。

text: Licence plates on Åland are white with blue text, making them appear almost completely white on Street View. They are noticeably quite **short** and **lack** the European blue strip on the left side.
text_zh: 奧蘭的車牌是白底藍字，這使得它們在街景服務上看起來幾乎完全是白色的。它們明顯相當**短**，且**缺少**左側的歐盟藍色條帶。

text: Some pedestrian signs on Åland have **four stripes**, with the exact same design found in Sweden. Beware that many pedestrian signs will still be the typical Finnish design.
text_zh: 奧蘭的一些行人標誌有**四條條紋**，其設計與瑞典完全相同。請注意，許多行人標誌仍然會是典型的芬蘭設計。

text: Bus stops on Åland include a **white plate** with 4 numbers. Some also include this semicircle sign on top.
NOTE: Some bus stops in Mariehamn do not follow this rule.
text_zh: 奧蘭的公車站包括一個帶有 4 個數字的**白色牌子**。有些也在頂部包含這個半圓形標誌。
註記：瑪麗港的一些公車站不遵循這項規則。

text: **Road 970** in the far north, on the border with Norway, is easily recognizable: it runs through a river valley with hills on both sides. The river is visible in many places, usually to the northwest. The birch trees around the road are small and stunted.
NOTE: The Generation 3 coverage on this road was taken in the autumn, meaning that the vegetation looks dead and mostly devoid of leaves.
text_zh: 位於最北端、與挪威邊境交界處的 **970 號公路**非常容易辨認：它穿過一條兩側都是山丘的河谷。河流在許多地方清晰可見，通常在西北方向。道路周圍的樺樹又小又矮。
註記：這條路上的第三代街景是在秋天拍攝的，這意味著植被看起來枯萎且大部分沒有葉子。

text: Due to its proximity to the Scandinavian Mountains, the area near Kilpisjärvi features a unique **hilly **landscape, with** low vegetation**.
NOTE: [The Generation 2 coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/32NoQ1mRjDmu5CsUA) on this road was taken during Spring, so the vegetation looks dead.
text_zh: 由於鄰近斯堪地那維亞山脈，基爾皮斯耶爾維附近的地區擁有獨特的**丘陵**地貌，並伴隨**低矮植被**。
注意：這條道路上的[第二代相機覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/32NoQ1mRjDmu5CsUA)是在春天拍攝的，因此植被看起來像是枯萎的。

text: Downtown Helsinki has a lot of Generation 4 **sidewalk trekker** coverage.
NOTE: This tip is specifically about Generation 4 trekker coverage. Generation 3 sidewalk trekkers can be found in many other Finnish cities.
text_zh: 赫爾辛基市中心有許多第 4 代**人行道徒步拍攝**覆蓋。
註記：這個提示專門關於第四代徒步拍攝街景。第三代人行道徒步拍攝街景可以在許多其他芬蘭城市找到。

text: Helsinki features these unique **green-**and-**yellow **trams.
NOTE: Tampere is the only other Finnish city with [trams](https://goo.gl/maps/zc9NtQZQvRpssehz8), but they are **red **instead of green and yellow.
text_zh: 赫爾辛基有這些獨特的**綠**黃**相間**電車。
注意：坦佩雷是芬蘭唯一另一個擁有[電車](https://goo.gl/maps/zc9NtQZQvRpssehz8)的城市，但它們是**紅色**的而不是綠黃相間。

text: The buses in and around Helsinki are typically **blue-**and-**white**, with a vertical split. Buses elsewhere can have the same colour scheme, so look for one of these logos on the bus.
text_zh: 赫爾辛基市內及周邊的公車通常是**藍白**相間，帶有垂直分割線。其他地方的公車也可能有相同的配色方案，所以請在公車上尋找其中一個標誌。

text: The buses in and around Tampere are blue on the bottom and white on the top. The word ‘NYSSE’ is written on the sides of the buses.
text_zh: 坦佩雷及其周邊的公車為下藍上白。公車側面寫著「NYSSE」這個詞。

text: Buses in Turku are uniquely **yellow**, with a white rear.
text_zh: 圖爾庫的公車是獨特的**黃色**，配有白色車尾。

text: Buses in Jyväskylä are almost completely **green**.
text_zh: 於韋斯屈萊的公車幾乎完全是**綠色**的。

text: Buses in Oulu have a **pink** front.
text_zh: 奧ulu的公車車頭是**粉紅色**的。

text: You can find **Red rectangular metallic plates** with 7 golden or dark red coloured protrusions that form a rounded hexagon shape on houses, lamp posts, and signposts in Tampere.
text_zh: 你可以在坦佩雷的房屋、路燈桿和路標上找到**紅色金屬長方形牌子**，上面有 7 個金色或深紅色的突起，形成一個圓潤的六邊形形狀。

text: This style of **blue street sign **with white text is unique to the cities of Seinäjoki and [Isokyrö](https://goo.gl/maps/SdmNDAwLzkXPyN6z6) southeast of Vaasa.
text_zh: 這種帶有白字的**藍色路標**風格是瓦薩東南方的塞伊奈約基和[伊索屈勒](https://goo.gl/maps/SdmNDAwLzkXPyN6z6)兩市所特有的。

text: Lahti uses these street signs with a **black border** and all capital letters.

NOTE: You can rarely find similar signs in other cities, but Lahti almost exclusively uses this design. Notably, Kuopio can use these [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/wjdzkPYj7ba2NRGN7), which use a thicker, more compact font.
text_zh: 拉赫蒂使用這些帶有**黑色邊框**且全是大寫字母的路牌。
注意：你很少能在其他城市找到類似的標誌，但拉赫蒂幾乎完全使用這種設計。值得注意的是，庫奧皮奧可以使用這些[標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/wjdzkPYj7ba2NRGN7)，它們使用的是更粗、更緊湊的字體。

text: The city of Kerava uses street signs with this **blue-**and-**yellow **[coat of arms](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keravan_vaakuna#/media/Tiedosto:Kerava.vaakuna.svg) in the top-left corner.
text_zh: 克拉瓦市使用左上角帶有這個**藍**黃相間[市徽](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keravan_vaakuna#/media/Tiedosto:Kerava.vaakuna.svg)的路標。

text: The city of Järvenpää uses street signs with this **blue-**and-**grey **[coat of arms](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A4rvenp%C3%A4%C3%A4n_vaakuna#/media/Tiedosto:Jarvenpaa.vaakuna.svg) in the top-left corner. The [neighbourhood](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1045971390202925086/1063500707099070514/Jarvenpaan_Alueet.png) name is also written above the street name.
NOTE: If you see a street sign with a coat of arms not mentioned in this guide, you should be near Kerava or Lahti.
text_zh: 耶爾文佩市使用左上角帶有這個**藍**灰相間[市徽](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A4rvenp%C3%A4%C3%A4n_vaakuna#/media/Tiedosto:Jarvenpaa.vaakuna.svg)的路標。[鄰里](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1045971390202925086/1063500707099070514/Jarvenpaan_Alueet.png)名稱也寫在街道名稱的上方。
注意：如果你看到的街牌上有本指南未提及的市徽，你應該就在凱拉瓦或拉赫蒂附近。
